name: Franklin Leasing & Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Franklin Leasing & Finance Ltd is in the business of lending and investment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
FLFL is registered as the Non Systematicallly Important Non Deposit Taking Non Banking Financial Corporation engaged primarily in advancing loans and investing /trading in securities. It also accepts loans and advances and offers variety of financial services to its customers.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.46 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.49% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 46.2 days to 170 days
